description.value:
You use magical tech to create a ring that's 1 inch thick, 10 feet wide, and 10 feet high. You must create the ring in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost. The ring contains a ripple in space-time that amplifies those that pass through it. Creatures or vehicles that move through the ring gain a +30-foot status bonus to their Speeds until the end of the turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Build Booster Ring]
